effects.description: Quaking Titan: Cannot perform free attacks until the start of its next turn.
effects.name: No Free Attack

props.description:
As long as your personal vehicle has a steed frame, it may have up to 2 active weapon modules (instead of 1).

As long as you have a martial armor equipped, you may use an action and spend 30 Mind Points to choose earth or physical. If you do, you deal 20 damage of the chosen type to every enemy you can see, and enemies that lose Hit Points this way cannot perform free attacks until the start of their next turn.

This effect deals 10 extra damage if you are driving a personal vehicle with a mech frame, or if you have two shields equipped and are not driving a personal vehicle with a steed frame; it also deals another 10 extra damage if you are level 30 or higher.

0.menu_title: Quaking Titan — choose a damage type

props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered one or more Classes among Guardian and Pilot.
props.implementation_note: Automated (Fabula Ultima playtest, October 1st, 2026): needs a martial armor equipped (HAS_MARTIAL_ARMOR; an equipped martial armor module counts, as the Techno Fantasy Atlas rules), asks earth or physical, deals 20 damage to every enemy, +10 with two shields equipped (EQUIPPED_SHIELD_COUNT; a Shield module counts as a shield), +10 at level 30 or higher. Each enemy that actually lost HP (not one that was immune, absorbed it, or had it soaked by a Shield buffer) gets No Free Attack until the start of its next turn. Not automated: driving. This engine has no driving state and treats modules as ordinary equipped gear, so the steed frame's second weapon module, the mech-frame +10 and the steed-frame exclusion of the two-shield bonus never apply.
props.name: Quaking Titan
